description: 42.1M-parameter decoder-only Transformer trained from scratch; final checkpoint of the Mini-R1 arithmetic-retention study.

checkpoint.note: Strip optimizer_state_dict for inference-only distribution (~169 MB).

tokenizer.note: Every digit 0-9 is an individual token; <think>/<answer> tags are atomic single tokens.

intended_use.primary: Research artifact for studying catastrophic forgetting, replay strategies and arithmetic generalization in small language models.
appropriate: Studying verified arithmetic supervision at small scale
Educational reference for a from-scratch Transformer
not_appropriate: Finance, health, or any decision where a wrong number carries cost

known_limitations: NOT a reasoning model: GSM8K 2.43% is statistically indistinguishable from direct-answer SFT (2.35%) - one problem out of 1,319.
Arithmetic is regime-local: 89.60% on trained 2-digit ranges, 20.00% just outside, 0.60% at 5 digits.
General-language perplexity regressed 2.9x from the 17.68 base to 50.74.
Zero multiple-choice capability: AQuA 0.00% with 0.0% full-format compliance.
77.3% 4-gram repetition on GSM8K under greedy decoding.
Single seed (42); no variance estimates for any result.
Benchmark numbers are conservative: the evaluation harness left-pads without an attention mask while the model uses learned absolute positions, measured at roughly 3-14 points of equation validity.
Emits fluent, correctly formatted, confidently wrong arithmetic - verify every equation deterministically before use.
No safety tuning, alignment, or content filtering was applied.
